en.hubeali: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from Fuzayl Bin Yasaar who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘Al-Emān includes Al-Islām, but Al-Islām does not include it. Al-Emān is what occurs in the hearts, and Al-Islām is what (makes permissible) the marriages, and the inheritances, and saving of the bloods are (flowing upon); and Al-Emān includes Al-Islām, and Al-Islām does not include Al Emān’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from Fudayl ibnYasar who has said the following: “

I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘Belief is inclusive of Islam but Islam is not inclusive of it. Belief is what sits in the heart and Islam is that which legalizes marriages and inheritance and protects lives. Belief is inclusive of Islam but Islam is not inclusive of belief.’”
